Research Project

ASR Project

A planned custom Arabic speech recognition model designed specifically for Abserny's gesture vocabulary and acoustic conditions. Currently in the research and planning phase.

Planned
ℹ
Current status Abserny v1.0 uses a gesture-only interface with no voice trigger words. The ASR project is a future research initiative to explore voice command as an additional optional input method.

Motivation

Abserny v1.0 deliberately uses gesture control rather than voice triggers, eliminating the false-positive problem common in always-listening systems (background noise, TV audio, conversations triggering unwanted scans).

A custom ASR model could eventually enable an optional voice mode for situations where gestures are inconvenient, with accuracy high enough to avoid the false-positive issues of general-purpose recognition systems.

Project Goals

  • Build a lightweight model trained specifically on Abserny's command vocabulary
  • Support Arabic (ar-SA) as the primary language, English as secondary
  • Achieve low false-positive rates in realistic noisy environments
  • Run entirely on-device with no internet connection
  • Integrate with the existing FSM as an optional activation path

Target Commands

The model would be trained on a small, specific vocabulary rather than full speech recognition — making the task more tractable and the model smaller.

  • "ابصر" (ibsar) — trigger scan
  • "كرر" (karrar) — repeat last result
  • "وضع" (wad') — change mode
  • "إعدادات" (i'dadat) — open settings
  • "إلغاء" (ilgha') — cancel

Technical Approach

Architecture candidates

  • Keyword spotting with a small CNN on MFCC features
  • Whisper Tiny fine-tuned on the target vocabulary
  • Wav2Vec2 Arabic fine-tuned for command detection

Dataset plan

  • Record 500+ samples per command from multiple speakers
  • Vary acoustic conditions: quiet, street noise, indoor reverberation
  • Include different Arabic regional accents
  • Augment with noise injection and room impulse response convolution

Roadmap

  • Define final command vocabulary and recording protocol
  • Collect initial dataset (phase 1: 200 samples per command)
  • Benchmark architecture candidates on accuracy vs. model size
  • Build TFLite export and integration test in Abserny
  • Public release as optional voice mode in a future app version
